target_customer: Robotics and drone companies that need to run large AI models on constrained edge hardware
problem: Robot foundation models are hard to compress and deploy on limited devices like Jetson boards, mobile NPUs and old PCs within strict latency budgets.
business_model: Developer infrastructure software (Instinct Edge runtime generation) with open source components
product_category: Edge inference and deployment infrastructure for physical AI

founders.name: Bill Jiao
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked on Siemens first multimodal foundation model and held two patents on tardigrade proteins as a high school junior. Degree not listed.

founders.name: Guanming Wang
founders.background_notes: YC page lists reinforcement learning research at DeepMind, robotics research at UCL Robotics Institute and Tsinghua University, and an ICRA paper at age 17. Degree not listed.

competitors.name: NVIDIA Jetson and TensorRT toolchain
competitors.what: Default hardware and optimization stack for edge robot models, including quantized vision language models
competitors.traction_then: dominant target in 2026 edge deployment papers and guides

technical_complexity.rationale: Distillation, quantization and runtime generation across many chips (Jetson, Apple Neural Engine, Snapdragon, ARM) with millisecond budgets is hard for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Compression techniques are published and chip vendors ship their own tools, so the moat rests on execution speed and hardware coverage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Chip vendors already supplied quantization toolchains in 2026; no action against this company found.

market_need_then: Surveys in 2026 describe VLA models as memory bound on edge hardware and Jetson as the dominant target, which shows demand for deployment tooling.

branding.domain_note: Uses general-instinct.com. No acquisition history found.
branding.community_and_virality: Open source projects InstinctFlash and InstinctRazor and a partnership post with Physical Intelligence; no independent brand press found.

brand_strength.rationale: Early stage; search results confuse the name with General Intuition, a different physical AI company, which hints at confusability.

outcome_analysis: The company is active in the Spring 2026 batch with two founders and no disclosed funding, so no outcome exists yet. Strengths are research credentials and a growing physical AI market, while the risk is that chip vendors and larger robotics players provide deployment tooling themselves.
notes: No funding found for General Instinct; results about General Intuition (320M Series A) are a different company and were excluded. The company site fetch returned only a title. A yespress profile fetch returned 403. Competitor list is thin because no dated startup competitors were found.
